avis.texte: This is my Folliculitis Journey and i include ALL THE PRODUCTS I USED to get rid of it. I got Folliculitis on my groin area, i had no idea what it was since i have never had it but it started spreading down my legs and leaving these dark marks/scars. The lesions started multiplying, i went to the doctors who gave me an ointment gel, which did absolutely nothing for me, it was an acne treatment. Since it started getting hotter and summer was near i knew i had to act fast or else i would have to wear pants all summer. First things first, from my research it states not to shave to prevent he spread of Folliculitis, so yes i did just that. I didn't shave for over a month...i know gross but it had to be done. *If you do decide to shave, use a new fresh blade every time you shave in order to prevent spread. Also if you have folliculitis on your legs don't use the same blade on your armpits etc. I looked up items on amazon and read reviews for "Almond Clear: Body Clearing Serum" https://www.amazon.com/gp/product/B0866B6CV1/ref=ppx_yo_dt_b_asin_title_o05_s00?ie=UTF8&th=1 I decided to give it a try, i started with Level 1 and used it with the Hibliclens antibacterial soap as everyone in the reviews did. I already had the soap since its so amazing and i recommend everyone have this soap in their home it works miracles. I was already using this soap by itself for about 2 weeks prior to buying the Almond Clear bottle and i noticed no difference. When i read that buyers were combining bot

avis.titre: It starts working on day 3It starts working on day 3
avis.texte: Well for starters im only on day 4 and i haven’t taken any result pictures. However, the stuff definitely makes your skin peel. What ive been doing is applying it to my entire body everyday. I wait a little while and then i use bio oil after because it leaves your skin extremely dry because your skin is technically peeling. So if you dont moisturize like 5-10 mins after it dries you will eventually have itchy flaky skin and scratching will be counterproductive to skin thats trying to shed and re-heal. What im going to do moving forward is just take a q tip and apply it directly to my dark spots because im using a lot of product by trying to treat every inch of my skin. Im focusing more on peeling just the dark spots. And also limit how much product i waste by just puttng it on my entire body. I did start using the level 2 on my faces and it has dried out my face , i havent seen any peeling on my face, its day 4 but i am noticing the skin on my face appears to be dying an im guessing itll start peeling in the next week or so to reveal new skin underneath. Im going to stick through it but next time I’ll probably buy level 1 serum for my face for a more gentle approach… this one my be too harsh. Its also its safe during pregnancy which made me want to try. Im pregnant so not able to get skin peels and use chemicals like that. This is like a slower chemical peel. It definitely peels and its definitely working its just too early to see any permanent results. Yes people say you wil

I'm definitely not happy and feel like I got fooled. I've been hearing great things from both Amazon and TikTok saying this product has them peeling like a snake by day 3 or a week later. Well I know that everyone's different, but I've applied it at least once daily for a while now, and I got nothing. I'll use the rest of this bottle, but if I don't see any results I'm done, and won't be re purchasing. Not to mention I tried to purchase the level one for my face, I had to keep approving the shipment and it kept getting more delayed so I finally cancelled it. Very unhappy with this purchase Update: so I'm still not peeling, however, the bumps I use to have has completely cleared up. I'm a bit dark downstairs but I'm getting lighter my underarms are definitely getting lighter and the bumps are completely gone. The company has been a gem they offered to help offered mean refund and 20% off my next order due to the inconvenience. They also explained how their product works on skin like mines. I'll keep on using

avis.titre: Finally Clear Skin and Confidence Again!
avis.texte: I've been using Almond Clear Serum since March 2026, and I just had to purchase my second bottle in June, so a little truly goes a long way. After struggling for years with acne, bumps, and breakouts on the back of my legs, bum and in the bikini area, I tried countless products and even prescription treatments from my doctor with little to no success. Almond Clear has been the first product that delivered real results. What impressed me most was how quickly it worked. I started noticing improvements within just a few days, and the results continued to get better over time. The bumps and breakouts significantly decreased, and my skin became much smoother and clearer. This is hands down the best product I have found for this issue. For the first time in a long time, I feel confident wearing a bikini without feeling like I need to cover up. If you've struggled with stubborn acne or folliculitis-like bumps in these areas, I highly recommend giving Almond Clear Serum a try.

run dont walk for this product!! I have very severe hyperpigmentation inner thighs/that whole area and it’s been like that since I’ve been in my early teens and has been an insecurity for me since being an adult, I’ve been considering getting laser hair removal to get rid of it but it’s expensive so I’ve been looking for a cheaper alternative for YEARS and have tried countless of products like kojic acid, lactic acid, soaps, etc. I have started using this a week and a half ago, twice a day on my inner thighs/whole entire region. and my hyperpigmentation is legit peeling off like a sticker, it’s still in the process of peeling, but some areas of my inner thighs are peeling off sticker like, I gently rub the peeling skin off in the shower with warm water everyday, and my skin is so much lighter already in those areas! I think it would clear all my hyperpigmentation down there, it just would probably take at least 2-3 months, but that’s okay! I just know that it works so far so I’ll keep up with it. Make sure to moisturize, I use aloe Vera.

This serum is AMAZING!! I’ve been using it daily now (first, morning and night, now every morning) for 6 months and it has completely cleared my stubborn body acne/folliculitis. It has boosted my confidence so much. Stay consistent and this product will change your life. I also recommend applying a good moisturizing cream like Cetaphil every night once you transition to daily/morning use. Beware the skin peeling in the first few weeks is no joke, but applying moisturizing cream really helps, especially once your body adjusts.

My first folliculitis breakout happened a few summers ago after shaving my legs (below the knees). I was left with extremely itchy, painful red bumps that lasted for months. It was embarrassing and uncomfortable, I avoided wearing anything but pants or midi/maxi skirts. Recently, I had another severe breakout after shaving again and was terrified it would turn into another months-long ordeal. I tried everything: benzoyl peroxide wash, AmLactin, glycolic acid, retinal, and Hibiclens on its own. Nothing helped. Then I stumbled upon this product and decided to try the 1 oz bottle first because of the price. I was honestly shocked by how quickly I saw results. It worked so well that I’ve since ordered the 4 oz bottle, it’s worth every penny. At first, I washed my legs with Hibiclens at night and then applied Almond Clear. After a few days, I started applying Almond Clear in the morning as well. I’m attaching before-and-after photos taken just 15 days apart. I’m so happy with this product. Fair warning: it will dry your skin out. Now that the bumps are under control, I either moisturize in the morning or apply Almond Clear, let it sit for a bit, and then follow with moisturizer. If you are dealing with folliculitis and nothing seems to help, you must give this a try!

avis.titre: I will follow up with my honest review in 1-2 months.
avis.texte: I haven't even received this product yet, but for now, I will give it a "five" based on the claims it makes and the variety of conditions it purports to treat as well as the successful reviews posted by those who have already used it. The only place my rating can go is down, so check back in around 1-2 months (which seems to be the timeframe in which other's have been able to say they can tell the product is working.) FYI...I have numerous minor skin conditions that appear from time to time, many that present the same as other's which I can't identify so I can treat with the proper meds. My dermatologist has even mistaken cellulitis for ringworm, therefore, he treated a fungal infection with an antibiotic, which doesn't work! (If you are wondering how one person has such an assortment of conditions, some are simply hereditary (eczema, nail fungus, allergic reactions etc. As for the rest, ask anyone involved in contact sports (mine was wrestling which wins the prize as the most "intimate" as far as direct physical contact with another person bodily fluids-sweat, blood, nasal discharge as well as simple poor hygiene and direct skin-skin contact.) So, yup, gross when you think about it afterward! I will address my review(s) separately for each suspected condition I encounter and note which, if any, it appears to help the most.
